description:
Got the Osmo Mobile 8 for the first time, but don't know how to set it up? Just follow the video and learn!

Osmo Mobile 8 unlocks smooth 360° horizontal spin and effortless low-angle shots. With a direct phone connection, enjoy native tracking that always keeps your loved ones in frame.

00:09 - 01:17 Charging and Powering On
01:17 - 02:45 Multifunctional Module
02:45 - 03:48 DJI Mimo
03:48 - 04:15 Storage

The Multifunctional Module combines human and pet tracking, lighting, and audio capture, ensuring your subject stays in focus—whether you're creating content, recording daily life, or joining a video call. Never miss a moment!
